purpose: Preserve encountered failures, their causes, repairs, and successful revalidation.

failures.failure: A combined background-server command was rejected by local command policy.
failures.repair: Split process launch, readiness, and ownership checks into separate commands.
failures.revalidation: Exact isolated listener PIDs were verified before each stop.

failures.failure: The pre-repair static/css path assumption found no directory.
failures.repair: Inspected the actual Turbopack static/chunks CSS asset referenced by rendered HTML.
failures.revalidation: The 10,675-byte partial custom bundle was hashed and shown to lack utility sentinels.

failures.failure: networkidle was unsupported by the in-app browser.
failures.repair: Used domcontentloaded plus visible H1 readiness.
failures.revalidation: All production routes rendered and stabilized.

failures.failure: The first generated CSS URL omitted /static and returned 404.
failures.repair: Used the exact stylesheet href emitted by production HTML.
failures.revalidation: The repaired CSS asset returned 200 with exact disk/response size.

failures.failure: The first Windows regression harness could not spawn npm.cmd.
failures.repair: Invoked Next and Vitest directly through the current Node executable.

failures.failure: JSDOM ignored Tailwind @layer utilities and initially computed nav as block.
failures.repair: Extracted exact emitted sentinel rules into a second cascade sheet and bound all spatial assertions to the real Chromium certificate.
failures.revalidation: Both CSS regression tests pass and the served CSS hash matches browser evidence.

failures.repair: Normalized rem lengths to pixels before minimum-card checks.
failures.revalidation: Card padding and radius gates pass.

failures.failure: The browser wrapper did not expose locator screenshots or scrollIntoViewIfNeeded.
failures.repair: Used grounded locator clicks to auto-scroll target headings before viewport capture.
failures.revalidation: Focused Score Receipt and Score Change screenshots were frozen.

failures.failure: Three guessed demo slugs returned expected 404s.
failures.repair: Derived the route list directly from frozen jobs.json IDs.
failures.revalidation: All six real job-detail routes return 200.

failures.failure: The first touch-target audit found 36–42px native selects.
failures.repair: Set the shared select minimum height to 44px and repaired detail heading order.
failures.revalidation: Visible native selects and mobile menu links measure 44px; detail begins with its H1.

failures.failure: The first recursive cleanup command was rejected by local command policy.
failures.repair: Resolved and verified the exact temporary directory inside build-week/bw5, then removed that explicit path with the native filesystem API.
failures.revalidation: The seven extracted review frames and their temporary directory are absent.

failures.failure: The first final CSS test rejected the intermediate bundle hash after evidence files entered Tailwind automatic source discovery.
failures.repair: Rebuilt against the complete final source set, preserved the initial browser-capture hash, and rebound generated-CSS evidence to the final emitted asset.
failures.revalidation: The final build-bound served-CSS and computed-cascade tests pass on the stable bundle.
